topics.description: The Trump administration's decision to withhold $259 million in Medicaid funding from Minnesota has escalated the fight between the state and the White House. The move is part of a 'war on fraud' and could presage similar crackdowns in other states.
topics.reason: High-profile allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota

topics.description: The FBI has been involved in various investigations related to fraud and corruption, including the seizure of assets and firing of agents who worked on high-profile cases.
